clips.title: The story
paras: Mull Thunderhorn prepares the Thunderhorn Cleansing Totem in Bloodhoof Village. Ancestral magic in the totem is meant to purify the Thunderhorn Water Well.

Mull Thunderhorn entrusts a prepared totem to travelers in Bloodhoof Village. They carry it north to the Thunderhorn clan's sacred spring, where foul agents have tainted the water. The ancestral wells dug by the tauren tribes nourish their herds and hunting grounds. Through ritual invocation, the totem calms the water's disturbed spirits and cleanses the site.
